author: Viva La Dirt League
description:
When young Charlie gets sad his imaginary friend Gruffles teaches him a neat new trick — Just Smile! This sketch explores toxic positivity and how hanging onto outdated coping mechanisms can hurt not help.

Made with the support of NZ On Air.

TW: This video may contain themes of depression, anxiety and mental health struggles. If you're struggling with your mental health, please seek help. Here are some worldwide resources that could help:
https://movember.com/mens-health/get-support
https://www.who.int/news-room/feature-stories/mental-well-being-resources-for-the-public
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_suicide_crisis_lines
https://unitedgmh.org/mental-health-support
https://www.helpguide.org/find-help.htm
